name: qa-automation-portfolio
description: Portfólio de automação de testes: Web, API, Database, Performance e CI/CD

scripts.test:performance:local:observe: API_URL=http://localhost:3000 k6 run --out experimental-prometheus-rw --tag testid=local performance/k6/smoke.test.js
scripts.observability:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d prometheus grafana test-metrics-exporter
scripts.observability:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml stop prometheus grafana test-metrics-exporter
scripts.observability:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f prometheus grafana test-metrics-exporter
scripts.alerting:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile alerting up -d alertmanager
scripts.alerting:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile alerting stop alertmanager
scripts.alerting:logs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile alerting logs -f alertmanager
